task_name: Render board cover thumbnails and overflow badge

concerns_addressed: Implementer concern that cycle 2 needed no extra production code — classified as observation/scope, confirmed valid: CardBody already consumes server-ordered card.attachments[0] (CardView.tsx:21-22); BoardContext setColumns(board.columns) passes getBoard columns through unchanged (BoardContext.tsx:382). The cycle-2 integration test hydrates that path without a client remapping or sort layer. Not a missing requirement.

strengths: Cover is attachments[0] from the T4 Card.attachments shape with no client-side re-sort; img src is the server thumbnailUrl, not a constructed /uploads path
Overflow badge is length-1 and only rendered when extraCount > 0, so 0 and 1 attachments show no +N; empty/undefined attachments skip the media slot and leave title/key readable
Tile has no lightbox, gallery, cover picker, reorder, tracker lookup, or attachment mutation; existing CardView onOpen remains card-open, not a gallery modal
Diff stays in the three scoped files; CardBody is extended in place per the packet; creative-brief tokens (rounded-md, border-neutral-200, bg-neutral-100, 10px overlay type) are used

Unit tests cover A/B/C → A plus +2, single cover without badge, empty list, and last-delete revert; integration test drives BoardProvider getBoard hydration into public CardBody without mocking cover selection
